name: 29160 · Swansea, SC
findings: ZIP 29160 (Swansea) has 12 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (67%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 7 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 29160 (Swansea) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 29160 (Swansea) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 50% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
